headline: Visa Shares Fall as Weak 2027 Outlook Overshadows Q4 Earnings Beat
summary: Visa shares dropped after a subdued 2027 guidance overshadowed an otherwise stronger-than-expected fourth-quarter earnings performance.
why: Visa is the world's largest payment processor and acts as a bellwether for global consumer spending and cross-border financial transactions.

impacts.name: Visa Inc.
impacts.why: Investors sold shares following a weaker-than-anticipated fiscal 2027 forward outlook.

impacts.name: Payment Services
impacts.why: Weaker forecast from market leader casts doubt over medium-term payment volume growth.

why_moved: Visa shares declined as investors focused on disappointing forward guidance for 2027 rather than its fourth-quarter earnings beat.
